name: Red-Tinged Doorway
disable: DC 35 Arcana check, DC 35 Occultism check, or DC 35 Thievery check (master); must have studied Carlina's notes

items.name: Warping Journey
items.text:
Trigger A creature passes through the doorway

---
Effect The creature is pulled apart and reassembled as they pass through multiple dimensions at once. The creature must attempt a DC 30 Will save save and disappears for a number of rounds, reappearing at the end of their turn on the final round. Each round at the beginning of their turn, creatures trapped in the doorway must succeed at a DC 32 Fortitude save save against a Cursed Metamorphosis spell as their bodies are warped and rearranged. A creature can pass through each red-tinged doorway only once.

---
Critical Success The creature disappears for 1 round. Additionally, the creature gains 10 temporary Hit Points for 24 hours. These stack with temporary Hit Points gained from other red-tinged doorways and replenish each day at midnight as long as the creature is within 1 mile of Narona.

Success The creature disappears for 1 round.

Failure The creature disappears for 2 rounds.

Critical Failure The creature disappears for 3 rounds. If the creature critically fails its saving throw against a cursed metamorphosis spell, it's permanently transformed into an amalgamite.

text: A swirling portal leads to unwholesome places.
